output.answer_markdown: At January 31, 2020, the company's primary interest rate exposure was from variable rate debt [1]. At January 29, 2021, that exposure had shifted to variable rate investment holdings classified as cash and cash equivalents [2]. The shift was driven primarily by the $1.5 billion of senior unsecured notes issued in the first quarter of 2020 to strengthen liquidity amid COVID-19 uncertainty [3].
